goal: advance an open research programme with a pre-registered experiment on real data
notes: Routed by weighted draw to research/0; pick_track.py drew christian-belief-models, claim check clear. New experiments/m6_allocation (run.py, summarise.py) over the GSS 1972-2024 cumulative file (NORC R3a, downloaded and checksum-verified): 73 families of 2-4 subgroups sharing an item, 13 items, 300 subsample draws per family x budget, budgets 50/100/200/400 per group, under a minute on 4 cores with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1. Predictions written to LOG.md and committed before the GSS run. Results: Neyman allocation changes group-average loss by under 1% (prediction 1 held); oracle composite 0.26 of D_eq at nbar=50 but still 0.56 at 400 (prediction 2 half held, oracle better than predicted at large budgets); Fay-Herriot shrinkage with tau2 from other items 0.50/0.69/0.80/0.89 (prediction 3 mostly held, narrowly missed at nbar=100: 0.685 vs 0.675); family-estimated tau2 costs 0.16 at nbar=50 and is worse than no shrinkage from 200 (prediction 4 held); pilot-then-water-fill 2-3% worse than equal-split shrinkage (prediction 5 held); worst-group RMSE ratio 0.75 not >1 (prediction 6 refuted, shrinkage helps the worst group too). Verification run here: 20 pytest tests pass (test_allocation 9 new, test_calibration, test_shift_bound); research/_homepage/build.py prints ok (1078 projects); check_md_links.py ok; research_live_links.py no changes; cite_check.py resolves all DOIs/arXiv ids including the two new ones (Neyman 1934, Fay-Herriot 1979).
